Cat's Eye ESP browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Cat's Eye Mista' Fuzz Published on September 18, 2005 Cat's Eye ESP fuzz pedal Controls Volume Fuzz Information Cat's Eye ESP This pedal is for the guitarist who wants classic "Jimi", but doesn't want all the problems that came with the original FuzzFace. Thru careful component selection, including the hand picked AC128 germanium transistors (for that classic Hendrix sound), and most of all, proper biasing, we've created a kickass fuzztone. We added true bypass switching, a Hi-Z input to drive the front end of any guitar amp, increased both the gain and the output levels, eliminated radio interference and oscillation, and reshaped the EQ for a better overall tone. Of course the Mista' Fuzz responds to a players own individual style and touch, and cleans up nicely using only your guitars volume knob, making subtle tone changes effortless.
